The official deadline for the headliner proposal for Glamsterdam has passed. There are ongoing discussions regarding slot restructuring versus slot shortening. FOCIL is compatible with both, though practically somewhat challenging with the latter. Discussions about the content for Glamsterdam will continue over the next few months. We encourage participation in FOCIL related discussions.

### Development

We are currently having a discussion on the [FOCIL consensus spec PR](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4351). The details can be found in the PR and a write-up summarizing the discussion will be published soon.
